title: Recent advances in research on the amygdala complex in sleep and anesthesia awakening: A hub for the integration of emotion and arousal.
summary: The amygdala complex (comprising the lateral, central, and medial amygdala) has traditionally been regarded as playing a central role in emotional learning and fear memory. However, recent studies have revealed its critical functions in the regulation of sleep cycles and recovery from anesthesia. This review proposes a new theoretical framework that views the amygdala complex as an "emotion-arousal integration network" that integrates internal emotional states with external environmental demands to dynamically regulate overall arousal levels and states of consciousness. This review first outlines the neuroanatomy and cellular composition of the various subnuclei of the amygdala, then systematically elaborates on the role of the basolateral amygdala in the regulation of the physiological sleep-wake cycle, and explores its new role in promoting the recovery of consciousness during general anesthesia. Building on this foundation, the review further analyzes the complementary roles of the central and medial amygdala in sleep regulation, as well as how functional imbalances in the amygdala lead to sleep and emotional symptoms in conditions such as post-traumatic stress disorder. Finally, the review outlines potential clinical translation strategies based on amygdala circuits and neurochemical mechanisms, and discusses current research challenges and future directions.

标题：杏仁核复合体在睡眠与麻醉觉醒中的研究进展：情绪与唤醒整合的枢纽
摘要：杏仁核复合体（包括外侧、中央和内侧杏仁核）传统上被认为在情绪学习和恐惧记忆中发挥核心作用。然而，近期研究揭示了其在睡眠周期调控和麻醉恢复中的关键功能。本综述提出了一种新的理论框架，将杏仁核复合体视为一个“情绪-唤醒整合网络”，该网络整合内部情绪状态与外部环境需求，以动态调节整体唤醒水平和意识状态。本综述首先概述了杏仁核各亚核的神经解剖学和细胞组成，然后系统阐述了基底外侧杏仁核在生理性睡眠-觉醒周期调控中的作用，并探讨了其在全身麻醉期间促进意识恢复的新角色。在此基础上，本综述进一步分析了中央和内侧杏仁核在睡眠调控中的互补作用，以及杏仁核功能失衡如何导致创伤后应激障碍等疾病中的睡眠和情绪症状。最后，本综述概述了基于杏仁核环路和神经化学机制的潜在临床转化策略，并讨论了当前的研究挑战和未来方向。
关键词：杏仁核复合体；情绪-唤醒整合；睡眠调控；麻醉觉醒；创伤后应激障碍

title: Multivariate decoding of EEG reveals key spatial and temporal distinctions in perception and valuation.
summary: Decisions often require the integration of multiple considerations or attributes. Yet despite considerable research, debate continues about the neural mechanisms underlying the calculation of individual attribute values. One key question centers on whether attribute values are computed solely within the valuation network or also within perceptual regions specialized for identifying specific attributes. While each account makes distinct predictions concerning when attribute value signals should emerge, these hypotheses remain untested. To this end, we investigated when attribute-specific valuation emerges relative to earlier perceptual and later integrated value processes. Participants first learned to associate different face and color stimuli with specific monetary payoffs. They then made choices based on these reward-associated attributes in a multi-attribute decision making task, during which we recorded participants' EEG activity. Using multivariate classification analyses, we found that perceptual representations could be decoded early and in parallel, but that attribute value decoding emerged in a more sequential manner, followed by evidence of integrated value representations. Spatially, perceptual representations were most distinct, with attribute value representations demonstrating closer alignment with integrated value than their respective perceptual components. Importantly, attribute values amplified their perceptual representations, but only after the emergence of the integrated value representation, suggesting a post hoc attentional selection mechanism. Collectively, our findings shed new light on prior work and highlight with clearer temporal precision the evolution from perceptual to evaluative to decisional computations.

标题：脑电多变量解码揭示感知与价值评估中的关键空间与时间差异
摘要：决策通常需要整合多种考量或属性。然而，尽管已有大量研究，关于个体属性价值计算的神经机制仍存在争议。一个关键问题在于，属性价值是仅在价值评估网络中计算，还是在专门用于识别特定属性的感知区域中计算。尽管每种解释对属性价值信号出现的时间做出了不同预测，但这些假设尚未得到检验。为此，我们研究了属性特异性价值评估相对于早期感知过程和后期整合价值过程出现的时间。参与者首先学习将不同的面孔和颜色刺激与特定金钱收益相关联。随后，他们在多属性决策任务中基于这些与奖励关联的属性做出选择，同时我们记录了参与者的脑电活动。通过多变量分类分析，我们发现感知表征可以在早期并行解码，而属性价值解码则以更序列化的方式出现，随后出现整合价值表征的证据。在空间上，感知表征最为区分明显，而属性价值表征与整合价值的对齐程度高于其各自的感知成分。重要的是，属性价值放大了其感知表征，但这仅发生在整合价值表征出现之后，提示一种事后注意选择机制。总体而言，我们的发现为先前研究提供了新见解，并以更清晰的时间精度突出了从感知到评估再到决策计算的演化过程。
关键词：脑电；多变量解码；属性价值；感知表征；多属性决策

title: Beyond white matter topology: cortical geometry shapes the spatial pattern of face-processing plasticity following auditory deprivation.
summary: The human brain can adapt its function in response to experience, and such plasticity mediates the influence of individual experience on cognition and behavior. Traditional accounts propose that functional brain plasticity is primarily driven by the rerouting of white matter fiber networks, that is, topological connectivity. However, accumulating evidence that intrinsic geometric features constrain neural dynamics raises the possibility that brain plasticity may also be shaped by cortical geometry. Yet, direct empirical support for this hypothesis remains scarce. Here, we combined a multivariate analytical framework with multimodal neuroimaging to examine how white matter topology and cortical geometry jointly constrain the group-level spatial pattern of face-processing plasticity following congenital auditory deprivation. Our results showed that auditory deprivation-induced functional plasticity primarily exhibited a spatial pattern of outward expansion from the core regions of the pre-existing face-processing network. Both white matter topology and cortical geometry were associated with the spatial distribution of this group-level plasticity map, with cortical geometry explaining a modest but greater portion of its spatial variance than topological connectivity. Whole-brain eigenmode analysis further showed greater alignment of face-processing activation with geometric eigenmodes in deaf participants at intermediate spatial scales, with no comparable differences for connectome eigenmodes. Moreover, cross-group predictive analyses indicated that structure-function associations involving topological and geometric properties can partially generalize across sensory experience. Taken together, these findings suggest that cortical geometry, as one component of the structural scaffold, contributes to the spatial organization of group-level functional plasticity alongside white matter topology, consistent with complementary structural constraints on its spatial pattern.

标题：超越白质拓扑：皮层几何形态塑造先天性听觉剥夺后面孔加工可塑性的空间模式
摘要：人脑能够根据经验调整其功能，这种可塑性介导了个体经验对认知和行为的影响。传统观点认为，功能性脑可塑性主要由白质纤维网络的重组所驱动，即拓扑连接。然而，越来越多的证据表明，内在几何特征约束神经动力学，这提示脑可塑性也可能受到皮层几何形态的塑造。然而，支持这一假设的直接实证证据仍然匮乏。在本研究中，我们结合多变量分析框架与多模态神经影像，考察白质拓扑和皮层几何形态如何共同约束先天性听觉剥夺后面孔加工可塑性的群体水平空间模式。我们的结果表明，听觉剥夺诱导的功能可塑性主要表现为从既有面孔加工网络核心区域向外扩展的空间模式。白质拓扑和皮层几何形态均与该群体水平可塑性图的空间分布相关，其中皮层几何形态解释的空间方差比例虽不大，但高于拓扑连接。全脑特征模态分析进一步显示，在中等空间尺度上，聋人参与者的面孔加工激活与几何特征模态的对齐程度更高，而连接组特征模态未表现出类似差异。此外，跨组预测分析表明，涉及拓扑和几何属性的结构-功能关联能够部分泛化于不同感觉经验。综上所述，这些发现表明，皮层几何形态作为结构支架的组成部分，与白质拓扑共同参与群体水平功能可塑性的空间组织，这与其空间模式受到互补性结构约束的观点一致。
关键词：皮层几何形态；白质拓扑；功能可塑性；面孔加工；听觉剥夺

title: Principal spatiotemporal pattern mapping detects brain activity partially decoupled with task timing.
summary: Neural activity arises from interactions between bottom-up sensory inputs and top-down information process, and thus may not be strictly time-locked to external task stimuli in function MRI (fMRI). Such temporal decoupling between stimuli and neural responses challenges the generalized linear model (GLM) that assumes fMRI signals as a convolution of a prior hemodynamic response function (HRF) with task timings, potentially leading to incomplete detections of task-evoked brain activations. To address this issue, we developed an HRF-model-free framework that detects task-evoked brain activations by capturing spatiotemporal pattern of fMRI signals within functional topography in the brain. Using this framework, we investigated neural dynamics of participants engaged in Human Connectome Project (HCP) emotion tasks. We identified neural activations in prefrontal subregions that exhibit partial temporal decoupling from task timing, rendering them undetectable by the GLM. These activations are likely driven by implicit events emerging from top-down information processes following the reception of external stimuli. Together, these findings suggest that task-evoked neural dynamics are shaped not only by externally events but also by autonomous cognitive process, underscoring the complex and interactive nature of brain function and highlighting the need for new analytical frameworks for task-based fMRI.

标题：主时空模式映射检测与任务时序部分解耦的脑活动
摘要：神经活动源于自下而上的感觉输入与自上而下的信息加工之间的相互作用，因此在功能磁共振成像（fMRI）中可能并不严格锁时于外部任务刺激。刺激与神经反应之间的这种时间解耦对广义线性模型（GLM）提出了挑战，因为GLM假设fMRI信号是先验血流动力学响应函数（HRF）与任务时序的卷积，这可能导致对任务诱发脑激活的检测不完整。为解决这一问题，我们开发了一种不依赖HRF模型的框架，通过捕捉脑功能拓扑内fMRI信号的时空模式来检测任务诱发的脑激活。利用该框架，我们研究了参与人类连接组计划（HCP）情绪任务的被试的神经动力学。我们识别出前额叶亚区中的神经激活，其表现出与任务时序的部分时间解耦，因而无法被GLM检测到。这些激活可能由接收外部刺激后自上而下信息加工所涌现的内隐事件驱动。总之，这些发现表明，任务诱发的神经动力学不仅由外部事件塑造，也由自主认知过程塑造，突显了脑功能的复杂性和交互性，并强调需要新的基于任务的fMRI分析框架。
关键词：功能磁共振成像；情绪任务；时空模式；血流动力学响应函数；广义线性模型

title: Spatio-temporal dynamics of safety learning during fear acquisition and fear generalization.
summary: Existing neural studies have predominantly focused on threat processing during fear acquisition and generalization, whereas the spatiotemporal dynamics of safety learning remain poorly understood. Here, we examined safety learning across early acquisition, late acquisition, and fear generalization, while characterizing early and late event-related potential (ERP) responses using a fear conditioning and generalization paradigm with multiple conditioning sets (N = 29). Behavioral ratings and reaction times indicated enhanced safety learning from early to late acquisition, together with a generalization gradient from threat to safety stimuli. Non-parametric cluster-based permutation tests (CBPT) revealed larger frontal N2 amplitudes to the safety cue than the threat cue across all experimental phases. During fear generalization, both the safety cue and the generalization stimuli (GS1-GS4) elicited larger occipital P2 amplitudes than the threat cue. The safety cue further elicited larger right frontocentral late positive potential (LPP) amplitudes than the threat cue and the generalization stimuli, as well as larger sustained anterior negativity (SAN) than the generalization stimuli. Descriptive source reconstruction suggested shifts in the estimated sources of the N2 from early to late acquisition, whereas source estimates of the P2, LPP, and SAN showed spatial overlap with medial prefrontal, limbic subcortical, occipitotemporal, medial temporal, medial parietal, and cerebellar regions. Together, these findings provide a preliminary characterization of the spatiotemporal dynamics of safety learning across fear acquisition and generalization and establish a normative framework for future investigations of altered safety learning in anxiety disorders.

标题：恐惧习得与恐惧泛化过程中安全学习的时空动态
摘要：现有神经研究主要关注恐惧习得与泛化过程中的威胁加工，而安全学习的时空动态仍知之甚少。本研究考察了早期习得、晚期习得和恐惧泛化阶段的安全学习，并采用包含多个条件化集合的恐惧条件化与泛化范式（N=29），刻画了早期和晚期事件相关电位（ERP）反应。行为评分和反应时表明，从早期习得到晚期习得，安全学习增强，同时呈现出从威胁刺激到安全刺激的泛化梯度。非参数聚类置换检验（CBPT）显示，在所有实验阶段中，安全线索诱发的额区N2波幅均大于威胁线索。在恐惧泛化期间，安全线索和泛化刺激（GS1-GS4）诱发的枕区P2波幅均大于威胁线索。安全线索还比威胁线索和泛化刺激诱发了更大的右额中央区晚期正电位（LPP）波幅，并比泛化刺激诱发了更大的持续性前部负波（SAN）。描述性源重建提示，N2的估计源从早期习得到晚期习得发生转移，而P2、LPP和SAN的源估计与内侧前额、边缘系统皮层下、枕颞、内侧颞、内侧顶叶和小脑区域存在空间重叠。总之，这些发现初步刻画了恐惧习得与泛化过程中安全学习的时空动态，并为未来研究焦虑障碍中安全学习改变建立了规范性框架。
关键词：安全学习；恐惧泛化；事件相关电位；时空动态；焦虑障碍

title: Social cognition as an under-used behavioural endpoint in neurodevelopmental psychopharmacology: A conditional framework for integrating theory of mind into clinical trial design.
summary: Social cognition, encompassing theory of mind (ToM), facial affect recognition, and mentalising under social load, is impaired across several neurodevelopmental disorders (NDDs), including autism spectrum disorder (ASD), attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD), developmental language disorder (DLD), and intellectual disability (ID). These impairments are plausibly downstream of neurochemical processes, particularly serotonergic, dopaminergic, neuropeptidergic, and excitatory-inhibitory modulation of prefrontal-temporal-limbic circuits, although this pathway is indirect and moderated by age, language, cognitive ability, and comorbidity. Despite this, performance-based social cognition is rarely positioned as a primary or co-primary endpoint in NDD pharmacotherapy trials. The predominant standard, the Aberrant Behavior Checklist Irritability subscale and its caregiver-rated relatives, indexes reactive behavioural output that may be construct-distant from the mechanisms through which several contemporary agents are hypothesised to act. This narrative review advances a conditional thesis: endpoint-mechanism misalignment is one plausible contributor to the uninterpretability of certain null trials, alongside insufficient power, sample heterogeneity, unverified target engagement, dosing limitations, high placebo response, and genuine inefficacy. We synthesise condition-specific social-cognitive profiles with graded evidence, the neurobiological substrates across mechanism classes, and a three-tier framework positioning social cognition as a co-primary endpoint for mechanism-matched agents and as a prespecified secondary or moderator variable otherwise. We set out the measurement and regulatory preconditions fit-for-purpose validation, adequate test-retest reliability, practice-effect control, and defined meaningful change that must precede such repositioning. We do not claim ToM should replace existing endpoints or that it suits all NDD trials.

标题：社会认知作为神经发育精神药理学中未充分利用的行为终点：将心理理论整合进临床试验设计的条件性框架
摘要：社会认知涵盖心理理论（ToM）、面部情绪识别以及社会负荷下的心智化，在多种神经发育障碍（NDDs）中均存在损害，包括自闭症谱系障碍（ASD）、注意缺陷/多动障碍（ADHD）、发育性语言障碍（DLD）和智力障碍（ID）。这些损害可能位于神经化学过程的下游，特别是前额-颞-边缘环路中血清素能、多巴胺能、神经肽能以及兴奋-抑制性调节过程，尽管该通路是间接的，并受年龄、语言、认知能力和共病情况的调节。尽管如此，基于表现的社会认知测评很少被设为主要或共同主要终点用于NDD药物治疗试验。当前主流标准——异常行为量表易激惹分量表及其照护者评定的相关量表——所测量的是反应性行为输出，可能与若干当代药物假设的作用机制在构念上相距较远。本叙述性综述提出一个条件性论点：终点与机制之间的错位，可能是某些阴性试验难以解释的一个合理原因，此外还包括统计效能不足、样本异质性、靶点参与未经验证、给药限制、高安慰剂反应以及真正的无效。我们综合了具有分级证据支持的各障碍特异性社会认知特征、跨机制类别的神经生物学基础，并提出一个三层框架，将社会认知定位为机制匹配药物的共同主要终点，而在其他情况下则作为预先指定的次要变量或调节变量。我们阐明了在此类重新定位之前必须满足的测量与监管前提条件：适用性验证、足够的重测信度、练习效应控制以及明确的有意义变化标准。我们并不主张ToM应取代现有终点，也不主张其适用于所有NDD试验。
关键词：社会认知；心理理论；神经发育障碍；临床试验终点；面部情绪识别

title: Altered right amygdala-prefrontal connectivity is associated with symptom severity in major depressive disorder: An exploratory analysis of anxiety subgroups.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Major depressive disorder (MDD) is highly prevalent and often complicated by anxiety symptoms, yet the neurobiological features associated with anxious depression remain incompletely characterized. The amygdala-prefrontal cortex (PFC) circuit, central to affect regulation, has been implicated in anxious depressive symptoms.
METHODS: We recruited 40 MDD patients and 69 healthy controls (HCs) from Tianjin Anding Hospital. All participants underwent resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging(fMRI) and clinical assessments. Seed-based functional connectivity (FC) analyses were performed using the bilateral amygdala based on the Automated Anatomical Labeling (AAL) atlas. Group comparisons, partial correlations, and regression analyses tested associations between amygdala-based FC and HDRS-17 symptom dimensions, with subgroup analyses distinguishing MDD patients with and without anxiety.
RESULTS: Compared with HCs, MDD patients exhibited reduced FC between the right amygdala and prefrontal cortex, including the right middle frontal gyrus (MFG) and the left inferior frontal gyrus, triangular part (IFGtri) (GRF: voxel-level p < 0.001, cluster-level p < 0.05). Within the MDD group, higher right amygdala-MFG FC values were associated with HDRS-17 symptoms, including total scores and depressive and somatic symptom dimensions (r = 0.393, p = 0.020; r = 0.360, p = 0.033; r = 0.351, p = 0.039, uncorrected p). In exploratory subgroup analyses, right amygdala-MFG FC showed a positive association with HDRS-17 scores in MDD patients with anxiety (R2 = 0.280, F = 8.957, p = 0.006, Beta = 0.529, t = 2.993, p = 0.006); however, the FC × anxiety subgroup interaction did not reach statistical significance.
CONCLUSION: Our findings identify disrupted right amygdala-MFG connectivity as a potential neural correlate of symptom heterogeneity in MDD, particularly in patients with anxiety symptoms.

标题：右侧杏仁核-前额叶连接改变与重性抑郁障碍症状严重程度相关：焦虑亚组的探索性分析
摘要：背景：重性抑郁障碍（MDD）患病率高，常合并焦虑症状，但焦虑性抑郁相关的神经生物学特征仍未完全明确。杏仁核-前额叶皮层（PFC）环路是情感调节的核心通路，已被认为与焦虑性抑郁症状有关。方法：我们从天津安定医院招募了40例MDD患者和69名健康对照（HCs）。所有参与者均接受了静息态功能磁共振成像（fMRI）和临床评估。基于自动解剖标记（AAL）图谱，以双侧杏仁核为种子点进行基于种子点的功能连接（FC）分析。采用组间比较、偏相关和回归分析检验杏仁核-based FC与HDRS-17症状维度之间的关联，并通过亚组分析区分伴焦虑和不伴焦虑的MDD患者。结果：与HCs相比，MDD患者右侧杏仁核与 prefrontal cortex之间的FC降低，包括右侧额中回（MFG）和左侧额下回三角部（IFGtri）（GRF：体素水平p < 0.001，团块水平p < 0.05）。在MDD组内，较高的右侧杏仁核-MFG FC值与HDRS-17症状相关，包括总分以及抑郁和躯体症状维度（r = 0.393，p = 0.020；r = 0.360，p = 0.033；r = 0.351，p = 0.039，未校正p）。在探索性亚组分析中，右侧杏仁核-MFG FC在伴焦虑的MDD患者中与HDRS-17评分呈正相关（R2 = 0.280，F = 8.957，p = 0.006，Beta = 0.529，t = 2.993，p = 0.006）；然而，FC × 焦虑亚组交互作用未达到统计学显著性。结论：我们的研究结果识别出右侧杏仁核-MFG连接 disrupted 可能是MDD症状异质性的潜在神经相关因素，尤其是在伴有焦虑症状的患者中。
关键词：重性抑郁障碍；杏仁核-前额叶连接；焦虑；功能磁共振成像；情绪调节

title: A multi-band spatial asymmetry convolutional neural network for EEG-based emotion recognition.
summary: Emotion recognition is an important component for enabling machines to perceive and respond to human emotions. Existing electroencephalogram (EEG)-based emotion recognition methods often rely on single-band signals or purely spatial representations, which may fail to capture complementary spectral information and left-right hemispheric asymmetry. To address these limitations, we propose a multi-band spatial asymmetry convolutional neural network (MBSACNN) for EEG-based emotion recognition. After baseline signal removal, EEG signals are decomposed into four frequency bands, namely theta, alpha, beta, and gamma. Based on the international 10-20 electrode system, two types of 3D inputs are constructed: the original EEG matrix (OEM) and the spatial asymmetric EEG matrix (SAEM). OEM preserves the original spatial distribution of multi-band EEG activities, whereas SAEM explicitly encodes the signed differences between symmetric electrode pairs to represent hemispheric asymmetry. A 2D CNN is then used to extract spatial-temporal features from the dual-input representations. Experiments on the DEAP dataset show that MBSACNN achieves average accuracies/F1-scores of 97.07%/97.19% for arousal and 96.61%/96.89% for valence, with accuracy standard deviations of 1.46% and 1.53%, respectively. The proposed model outperforms representative conventional and deep-learning baselines, including DT, MLP, CNN-RNN, DGCNN, 4D-CRNN, BiDCNN, EmT, and miMamba. Ablation analyses further demonstrate that multi-band decomposition, spatial asymmetry modeling, the signed asymmetric operation, and the 4 × 4 convolution kernel jointly contribute to the accuracy and stability of MBSACNN.

标题：一种用于基于脑电情绪识别的多频带空间不对称卷积神经网络
摘要：情绪识别是使机器能够感知并回应人类情绪的重要组成部分。现有的基于脑电图的情绪识别方法通常依赖单频带信号或纯空间表征，这可能无法捕捉互补的频谱信息和左右半球不对称性。为解决这些局限，我们提出了一种用于基于脑电情绪识别的多频带空间不对称卷积神经网络（MBSACNN）。在去除基线信号后，脑电信号被分解为四个频带，即theta、alpha、beta和gamma。基于国际10-20电极系统，构建了两类三维输入：原始脑电矩阵（OEM）和空间不对称脑电矩阵（SAEM）。OEM保留多频带脑电活动的原始空间分布，而SAEM显式编码对称电极对之间的带符号差异以表征半球不对称性。随后使用二维CNN从双输入表征中提取时空特征。在DEAP数据集上的实验表明，MBSACNN在唤醒度上达到平均准确率/F1分数97.07%/97.19%，在效价上达到96.61%/96.89%，准确率标准差分别为1.46%和1.53%。所提出的模型优于代表性的传统和深度学习基线，包括DT、MLP、CNN-RNN、DGCNN、4D-CRNN、BiDCNN、EmT和miMamba。消融分析进一步表明，多频带分解、空间不对称建模、带符号不对称操作以及4×4卷积核共同促进了MBSACNN的准确性和稳定性。

title: Affective reactivity to a remote computer-based Trier Social Stress Test during a planned quit attempt: associations with short-term cigarette smoking lapse risk.
summary:
BACKGROUND: The Trier Social Stress Test (TSST) elicits affective responses and has been linked to smoking behavior. However, its remote use during a planned quit attempt-when stress reactivity may influence early lapse-remains understudied.
OBJECTIVE: To quantify affective reactivity to a remotely administered TSST on a planned quit date following overnight abstinence and evaluate associations with cigarette use and lapse within 48 h.
METHODS: This secondary analysis used data from a randomized controlled trial of adult smokers completing a remotely administered TSST following overnight nicotine abstinence. Urge, anxiety, and stress were assessed using visual analog scales and summarized using area under the curve (AUC) metrics. Smoking outcomes included cigarette count and lapse within 48 h. Associations were estimated using generalized estimating equations.
RESULTS: In adjusted models, anxiety reactivity-but not urge or stress-was associated with cigarette count and lapse. Greater anxiety exposure (AUCtot) and change above baseline (AUCab) were associated with higher cigarette count (IRR=1.0004, 95%CI:1.0002-1.001, p=.002; IRR=1.01, 95%CI: 1.002-1.01, p=.002) and increased odds of lapse (OR=1.001, 95%CI: 1.0001-1.002, p=.03; OR=1.02, 95%CI: 1.001-1.03, p=.03). Effect sizes were small.
CONCLUSIONS: Anxiety reactivity under nicotine deprivation was associated with increased cigarette use and lapse 48 h post quit attempt, suggesting individual differences in stress-evoked anxiety may serve as a behavioral marker for early lapse. Remote TSST administration appears feasible for eliciting affective responses on a quit date.

标题：计划戒烟期间对远程计算机化特里尔社会应激测试的情感反应性：与短期吸烟复吸风险的关联
摘要：
背景：特里尔社会应激测试（TSST）可诱发情感反应，并已被证实与吸烟行为相关。然而，在计划戒烟期间远程使用该测试——此时应激反应性可能影响早期复吸——仍缺乏充分研究。
目的：量化在整夜戒断后于计划戒烟日远程实施TSST所引发的情感反应性，并评估其与48小时内吸烟行为及复吸的关联。
方法：本二次分析使用了一项随机对照试验的数据，纳入完成远程TSST的成年吸烟者，测试前进行整夜尼古丁戒断。使用视觉模拟量表评估渴求、焦虑和压力，并以曲线下面积（AUC）指标进行汇总。吸烟结局包括48小时内的吸烟支数和复吸。采用广义估计方程估计关联。
结果：在调整模型中，焦虑反应性——而非渴求或压力——与吸烟支数和复吸相关。更大的焦虑暴露量（AUCtot）和高于基线的变化量（AUCab）与更高的吸烟支数（IRR=1.0004，95%CI：1.0002-1.001，p=.002；IRR=1.01，95%CI：1.002-1.01，p=.002）及复吸几率增加（OR=1.001，95%CI：1.0001-1.002，p=.03；OR=1.02，95%CI：1.001-1.03，p=.03）相关。效应量较小。
结论：尼古丁戒断状态下的焦虑反应性与戒烟尝试后48小时内吸烟量增加及复吸相关，提示应激诱发焦虑的个体差异可能作为早期复吸的行为标记。远程实施TSST在戒烟日诱发情感反应方面具有可行性。
关键词：特里尔社会应激测试；情感反应性；焦虑；吸烟复吸；尼古丁戒断

title: Associations of affective states and cognitive functions with eating behavior in healthy young Korean adults.
summary: Altered eating behaviors have been identified in various psychiatric disorders; however, the psychological and cognitive correlates of eating-behavior traits in healthy young adults remain unclear. This cross-sectional study investigated whether affective states and cognitive functions are associated with eating behaviors in young Korean adults, hypothesizing that both affective and cognitive factors would be linked to maladaptive eating tendencies. One hundred healthy adults (50 men and 50 women, average age 21.88 ± 0.19 years) were recruited from March 2021 to June 2022. Eating-behavior traits were assessed using the Adult Eating Behaviour Questionnaire (AEBQ). Affective states were evaluated using the Autism-Spectrum Quotient, Depression Anxiety Stress Scale (DASS), Buss-Perry Aggression Questionnaire, and Big Five Inventory. Visual working memory, reward sensitivity, and salivary biomarkers, including cortisol and serotonin, were also assessed. AEBQ-based eating-behavior traits were more consistently associated with affective states than with cognitive-function indices or salivary biomarkers. Total AEBQ scores were positively associated with total DASS scores. Contrary to the initial hypothesis regarding cognitive functions, reward sensitivity and visual working memory showed no significant associations with AEBQ subscales. Salivary serotonin and cortisol were also not significantly associated with AEBQ subscales. These findings suggest that AEBQ-based eating-behavior traits in healthy young Korean adults may be more closely related to affective states than to cognitive-function indices or salivary biomarkers. Given the cross-sectional design, the findings should be interpreted as associative rather than causal or predictive.

标题：健康韩国年轻人情感状态和认知功能与进食行为的关联
摘要：进食行为的改变已在多种精神疾病中被发现；然而，健康年轻人中进食行为特质的心理和认知相关因素仍不清楚。这项横断面研究考察了情感状态和认知功能是否与韩国年轻人的进食行为相关，假设情感和认知因素均与适应不良的进食倾向有关。研究于2021年3月至2022年6月招募了一百名健康成年人（50名男性和50名女性，平均年龄21.88 ± 0.19岁）。进食行为特质采用成人进食行为问卷（AEBQ）进行评估。情感状态采用孤独症谱系商数、抑郁焦虑压力量表（DASS）、Buss-Perry攻击问卷和五大人格量表进行评估。同时评估了视觉工作记忆、奖赏敏感性和唾液生物标志物，包括皮质醇和血清素。基于AEBQ的进食行为特质与情感状态的关联比与认知功能指标或唾液生物标志物的关联更为一致。AEBQ总分与DASS总分呈正相关。与最初关于认知功能的假设相反，奖赏敏感性和视觉工作记忆与AEBQ各分量表无显著关联。唾液血清素和皮质醇也与AEBQ各分量表无显著关联。这些发现表明，健康韩国年轻人中基于AEBQ的进食行为特质可能与情感状态的关系比与认知功能指标或唾液生物标志物的关系更为密切。鉴于横断面设计，这些发现应被解释为关联性而非因果性或预测性。

title: Long-term social cognitive impairment after ischemic stroke: Frequency and association with lesion volume and location in an exploratory pilot study.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Social cognition, with emotion recognition (ER) being a key component, is recognized as a core cognitive domain, yet research on ER post-stroke remains limited. This exploratory pilot study aimed to provide preliminary estimates of long-term ER impairment after stroke and to examine its association with lesion volume and location.
METHODS: We invited patients <65 years, admitted for endovascular treatment (EVT) and included in a prospective cohort; the Oslo Acute Reperfusion Stroke Study, to participate in a 4-year follow-up study, and a healthy control (HC) group. ER was assessed using the "Pictures of Facial Affect" (PFA) test, impairment defined as performance ≥1.5 SD below HC mean. Linear regression analysis examined relationship between baseline predictors and ER at follow-up. Voxel-based lesion-symptom mapping (VLSM) were used to identify brain regions associated with ER, complemented by disconnectome mapping.
RESULTS: Of 109 participants included, 40 completed a 4-year follow-up including the PFA test (24 (60%) women, mean age 51 (SD ± 10) years). ER impairment was detected in 9 (23%) patients. Stroke lesion volume was significantly associated with PFA scores in both univariable and multivariable analysis, adjusted for sex, education, and time to recanalization. VLSM revealed associations between right-hemisphere cortical regions and lower PFA scores, notably the inferior parietal lobule and and adjacent perisylvian cortex.
CONCLUSIONS: Emotion recognition impairment was identified in more than one in five stroke patients four years after EVT. These preliminary findings identify stroke lesion burden and location as candidate group-level prognostic markers that warrant confirmation in larger studies of this under-researched cognitive domain.

标题：缺血性卒中后长期社会认知损害：一项探索性初步研究中损害频率及其与病灶体积和位置的关联
摘要：背景：社会认知被认定为核心认知领域之一，其中情绪识别（ER）是关键组成部分，但卒中后ER的研究仍较为有限。本探索性初步研究旨在初步估计卒中后长期ER损害的发生情况，并考察其与病灶体积和位置的关联。
方法：我们邀请年龄<65岁、因血管内治疗（EVT）入院并纳入前瞻性队列——奥斯陆急性再灌注卒中研究的患者，参加一项为期4年的随访研究，同时纳入健康对照（HC）组。采用“面部情绪图片”（PFA）测试评估ER，损害定义为表现低于HC均值≥1.5个标准差。采用线性回归分析检验基线预测因素与随访时ER之间的关系。采用基于体素的病灶-症状映射（VLSM）识别与ER相关的脑区，并以断连映射作为补充。
结果：共纳入109名参与者，其中40名完成了包括PFA测试在内的4年随访（24名（60%）女性，平均年龄51岁（SD±10））。9名（23%）患者检出ER损害。在单变量和多变量分析中，校正性别、教育程度和再通时间后，卒中病灶体积均与PFA评分显著相关。VLSM显示右半球皮层区域与较低的PFA评分相关，尤其是顶下小叶及其邻近的外侧裂周围皮层。
结论：在接受EVT治疗4年后的卒中患者中，超过五分之一存在情绪识别损害。这些初步发现提示，卒中病灶负担和位置可作为群体层面的候选预后标志物，值得在这一研究不足的认知领域开展更大规模研究加以验证。
关键词：情绪识别；社会认知；缺血性卒中；病灶体积；基于体素的病灶-症状映射

title: 50-kHz ultrasonic vocalization subtypes emitted by female rats anticipating same-sex social interaction.
summary: Adult rats possess a wide repertoire of 50-kHz ultrasonic vocalizations (USVs), with the "trill" and "flat" call subtypes appearing to capture positive or negative affect, respectively. USVs emitted during reward anticipation remain poorly characterised but might provide a measure of anticipatory anhedonia, a common feature of major depressive disorder. The present study investigated whether USV measures (specifically 50-kHz call rate and call subtype prevalence) would be modified in adult female Long-Evans rats anticipating access to a familiar social partner vs. no partner. The study also examined whether chronic treatment with oral corticosterone, intended to induce a depressive-like state, would inhibit the anticipation-associated changes in USV measures; chronic oral fluoxetine (antidepressant) was subsequently tested in the same animals. Corticosterone and fluoxetine treatment left 50-kHz call emission largely unchanged, while the independent measure of a depressive-like state (sucrose preference) proved inconclusive. Independent of drug treatment, rats emitted more 50-kHz calls while anticipating access to a social partner vs. access to an empty compartment. As predicted, social anticipation increased the preferential emission of the 50-kHz trill call subtype. Three less studied 50-kHz call subtypes also changed in relative prevalence during social anticipation: short calls were suppressed, while the flat-trill and trill with jumps subtypes were promoted. These findings suggest that 50-kHz call subtypes other than the widely studied flat and trill calls can potentially serve as markers of affect.

title: Emotions, the amygdala, and the right hemisphere.
summary: No effort has still been made to integrate within a general model of emotions the relations between amygdala, fear (and other emotions) and the right hemisphere. This integration is the aim of this review that will start with the description of a model viewing emotions as a primitive adaptive system, alternative to the cognitive system. I will then analyze the main characteristics of the amygdala and of its subcortical pathway that allows to detect, with an urgency procedure, life-threatening stimuli, and to provide, with automatic and unconscious processing modalities, rough sensory data to the amygdala. Since this subcortical pathway is lateralized to the right hemisphere in humans, but not in animals, the reasons of this evolution will be discussed with reference to the "crowding model" , which assumes that brain lateralization may serve to avoid conflicts between systems (such as the emotional and the cognitive ones) competing at the decisional level. This model could explain the left lateralization of language and the consequent complex renovation of the working modalities of both hemispheres. Support to this model comes from the observation that the right hemisphere is characterized not only by a greater representation of emotions, but also by automatic and unconscious processing modalities typical of the emotional system, whereas the left hemisphere is characterized by language-mediated conscious and intentional functioning modalities.

标题：情绪、杏仁核与右半球
摘要：目前尚无研究将杏仁核、恐惧（及其他情绪）与右半球之间的关系整合进一个通用的情绪模型之中。本综述旨在实现这一整合，首先介绍一种将情绪视为原始适应性系统、与认知系统相并列的模型。随后，我将分析杏仁核及其皮层下通路的主要特征，该通路能够通过紧迫性程序探测威胁生命的刺激，并以自动化和无意识的加工方式向杏仁核提供粗略的感觉数据。由于该皮层下通路在人类中偏侧化于右半球，而在动物中则不然，本文将结合“拥挤模型”讨论这一进化的原因。该模型假设脑偏侧化可能有助于避免在决策层面相互竞争的系统（如情绪系统与认知系统）之间产生冲突。这一模型可以解释语言的左偏侧化以及由此导致的左右半球工作模式的复杂重构。支持该模型的证据来自以下观察：右半球不仅表现出更强的情绪表征，还表现出情绪系统所特有的自动化和无意识加工模式，而左半球则以语言中介的有意识和有意向性的功能模式为特征。

title: Reducing state anxiety with alpha-frequency transcranial alternating current stimulation.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Anxiety reactivity to acute stress is a transdiagnostic vulnerability factor. We tested whether a single session of alpha-frequency transcranial alternating current stimulation (tACS) targeting the frontoparietal control network reduces stress-evoked state anxiety in healthy adults.
METHODS: In a randomized, blinded, sham-controlled study, 42 participants (mean age 58.9 years) completed an acute stress task before and after stimulation. The task was an adapted moving-circles paradigm in which circle collisions triggered a brief aversive event (mild electric shock plus unpleasant noise and a white flash). Active stimulation consisted of 20 min of 10-Hz tACS (2.0 mA/channel; 30-s ramp up/down) delivered via electrodes at F3, P3, Cz, and T7 (0° phase at F3/P3; 180° at Cz/T7). Sham stimulation used the same montage and ramp periods but no sustained current.
RESULTS: State anxiety showed a significant Time × Protocol interaction (F(1,35) = 4.22, p = .047): STAI-S decreased after active tACS (Δ = -3.16) but increased slightly after sham (Δ = +1.17). Perceived stress appraisal (SAAS) did not change. Resting-state alpha power at F3/P3 showed no reliable pre-post effects. During the task, left-frontal relative alpha differed by protocol and showed a trend toward larger increases following active tACS. Electrodermal and pupil indices changed across sessions in both groups, with no differential stimulation effects.
CONCLUSIONS: A single alpha-tACS session produced a modest, selective reduction in stress-evoked state anxiety, supporting oscillatory neuromodulation as a scalable approach to dampen anxiety reactivity.

标题：利用α频率经颅交流电刺激降低状态焦虑
摘要：背景：对急性应激的焦虑反应是一种跨诊断的易感性因素。我们检验了单次靶向前额顶控制网络的α频率经颅交流电刺激（tACS）是否能降低健康成年人应激诱发的状态焦虑。方法：在一项随机、盲法、假刺激对照研究中，42名参与者（平均年龄58.9岁）在刺激前后完成了一项急性应激任务。该任务为改编版移动圆圈范式，其中圆圈碰撞会触发短暂厌恶事件（轻度电击加上不愉快噪声和白色闪光）。主动刺激包括20分钟的10 Hz tACS（每通道2.0 mA；30秒渐升/渐降），通过F3、P3、Cz和T7电极施加（F3/P3为0°相位；Cz/T7为180°）。假刺激使用相同电极布局和渐升/渐降时段，但不施加持续电流。结果：状态焦虑表现出显著的时间×方案交互作用（F(1,35)=4.22，p=.047）：STAI-S在主动tACS后下降（Δ=-3.16），但在假刺激后略有上升（Δ=+1.17）。感知压力量表（SAAS）未发生变化。F3/P3静息态α功率未显示可靠的刺激前后效应。任务期间，左额相对α因方案不同而异，并显示出主动tACS后增幅更大的趋势。两组在会话间皮肤电和瞳孔指标均发生变化，但未发现刺激的差异效应。结论：单次α-tACS session产生了适度且选择性的应激诱发状态焦虑降低，支持振荡神经调控作为一种可扩展的方法来减弱焦虑反应性。

title: Arousal contribution on valence-driven affective modulations of time perception.
summary: Emotional stimuli distort time perception, but whether these effects are driven primarily by arousal or depend critically on emotional valence remains unclear. To fill this gap, here we conducted two experiments investigating how emotional valence and physiological arousal contribute to temporal distortions across multiple timing tasks and temporal scales. Both experiments employed immersive emotional video clips (positive, negative, neutral) combined with physiological recordings (electrocardiography, electrodermal activity) and three timing tasks: finger tapping (sub-second range), time production (one minute), and retrospective duration judgment (several minutes). In Experiment 1 we employed a within-subjects design (N = 41), while Experiment 2 we adopted a between-subjects approach (N = 38) to control for carryover effects. Subjective ratings confirmed successful emotional manipulation across both experiments. Emotional videos consistently accelerated motor timing in the finger-tapping task regardless of valence. However, valence-specific effects on time production emerged only under specific presentation orders in Experiment 1, with positive stimuli shortening and negative stimuli lengthening perceived duration. Retrospective judgments remained largely unaffected. Skin conductance responses showed sustained activation following emotional stimuli, whereas heart rate changes were inconsistent. Our results indicate that emotional influences on time perception are selective, task-dependent, and highly sensitive to contextual factors including stimulus order and prior emotional exposure. These findings challenge purely arousal-driven models and suggest that temporal distortions emerge from dynamic interactions between affective appraisal, attentional engagement, motor readiness, and emotional history. The dissociation between prospective and retrospective timing highlights the importance of attentional allocation in emotion-induced temporal distortions.

标题：唤醒度在效价驱动的时间知觉情感调制中的作用
摘要：情绪刺激会扭曲时间知觉，但这些效应究竟主要由唤醒度驱动，还是关键依赖于情绪效价，仍不清楚。为填补这一空白，我们开展了两个实验，考察情绪效价和生理唤醒如何在多种计时任务和时间尺度上促成时间扭曲。两个实验均采用沉浸式情绪视频片段（积极、消极、中性），并结合生理记录（心电图、皮肤电活动）以及三种计时任务：手指敲击（亚秒范围）、时间产生（一分钟）和回溯性时长判断（数分钟）。实验一采用被试内设计（N = 41），实验二采用被试间设计（N = 38）以控制延续效应。主观评分证实两个实验均成功实现了情绪操纵。情绪视频在手指敲击任务中一致地加快了运动计时，且不受效价影响。然而，效价特异性效应仅出现在实验一的特定呈现顺序下：积极刺激缩短了主观时长，消极刺激则延长了主观时长。回溯性判断基本不受影响。皮肤电传导反应在情绪刺激后表现出持续激活，而心率变化则不一致。我们的结果表明，情绪对时间知觉的影响具有选择性、任务依赖性，并且对刺激顺序和先前情绪暴露等情境因素高度敏感。这些发现挑战了纯粹的唤醒驱动模型，并提示时间扭曲源于情感评估、注意参与、运动准备和情绪历史之间的动态交互。前瞻性与回溯性计时之间的分离凸显了注意分配在情绪诱发时间扭曲中的重要性。
关键词：情绪效价；生理唤醒；时间知觉；计时任务；注意分配

title: Neural alterations in Pavlovian reversal learning link childhood trauma and transdiagnostic anxiety in youth.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Pavlovian reversal learning (RL) is a potential pathway linking childhood trauma (CT) with psychopathology. RL describes the ability to flexibly update associations of stimuli with threat and safety based on changing contextual significance. This study aims to characterize how CT may alter the neural underpinnings of RL in youth in ways relevant to mental health.
METHODS: One hundred participants aged 9-19, half with CT (i.e., interpersonal violence) exposure, completed a RL task during an fMRI scan. One previously-neutral stimulus was paired with an aversive stimulus and predicted threat (CS+); another was not and predicted safety (CS-). Then, contingencies were reversed, such that the old safety cue became the new threat cue (New CS+) and vice-versa. Regions-of-interest analyses and nonparametric mediation models with 10,000 simulations were used to examine patterns of neural activation and connectivity and whether they indirectly linked CT with psychopathology.
RESULTS: Youth with CT displayed elevated threat RL (New CS+ > New CS-) in amygdala; reduced safety RL (New CS- > New CS+) in canonical safety-learning regions, including ventromedial prefrontal cortex, hippocampus, and posterior parahippocampal gyrus (PHG); and elevated hippocampus-anterior cingulate cortex connectivity during safety RL. Critically, there were indirect effects of CT on transdiagnostic psychopathology through reduced safety RL in hippocampus and PHG, such that trauma-related reductions in discrimination between reversed cues were associated with lower levels of generalized anxiety and panic symptoms, findings driven by associations within the trauma group.
CONCLUSIONS: Alterations in RL following CT during this key developmental window may reflect an environmental experience-dependent pathway to resilience.

标题：巴甫洛夫反转学习中的神经改变将童年创伤与青少年跨诊断焦虑联系起来
摘要：背景：巴甫洛夫反转学习（RL）是连接童年创伤（CT）与精神病理学的潜在通路。RL描述了基于不断变化的情境意义灵活更新刺激与威胁和安全之间关联的能力。本研究旨在表征CT如何以与心理健康相关的方式改变青少年RL的神经基础。方法：一百名9-19岁参与者（其中一半有CT暴露，即人际暴力）在fMRI扫描期间完成了RL任务。一个先前中性的刺激与厌恶刺激配对并预测威胁（CS+）；另一个则不配对并预测安全（CS-）。随后， contingency被反转，使得旧的安全线索成为新的威胁线索（新CS+），反之亦然。采用感兴趣区分析和10,000次模拟的非参数中介模型来检验神经激活与连接模式，以及它们是否间接地将CT与精神病理学联系起来。结果：有CT的青少年在杏仁核中表现出威胁RL升高（新CS+ > 新CS-）；在经典安全学习区域（包括腹内侧前额叶皮层、海马体和后海马旁回PHG）表现出安全RL降低（新CS- > 新CS+）；并在安全RL期间表现出海马体-前扣带回皮层连接增强。关键的是，CT通过海马体和PHG中降低的安全RL对跨诊断精神病理学产生间接效应，即创伤相关的反转线索辨别能力降低与较低水平的广泛性焦虑和惊恐症状相关，这些发现由创伤组内的关联所驱动。结论：在这一关键发育窗口期，CT后RL的改变可能反映了一条环境经验依赖的韧性通路。
关键词：童年创伤；反转学习；焦虑；神经影像；海马体
